tools.name: compare_captcha_costs
tools.description: Open the CAPTCHA cost calculator and compare published rates for a challenge and monthly solve count. Applies inputs to the visible page. Preserves vendor labels, variants and price ranges; sorts by the low estimate. Returns dated sources and disclosed visit links. Compares prices, not success rates. Calculation only; no solving or purchase.

tools.name: compare_proxy_costs
tools.description: Open the proxy cost calculator and compare saved monthly prices for your GB, proxy type, signup and payment filters. Applies inputs to the visible page, shows matching providers cheapest estimate first, and returns dated sources and disclosed visit links. Omitted filters reset to the schema defaults. Calculation only; no purchase.

noId.description: Only vendors stating no ID or email-only signup.

tools.name: compare_scraping_api_costs
tools.description: Open the scraping API calculator and compare saved subscription prices for standard pages per month. Applies inputs to the visible page. Returns fitting plans sorted by monthly price, providers whose ladders are too small, unconverted credit multipliers, evidence limits, and disclosed visit links. Calculation only; no purchase.

pages.description: Standard successful pages per month, one credit each.
